description: Authoritative data stores for Product Forge. One truth per concern, one writer per file. Enforced by scripts/dev/wired_audit.py (store_audit).
rules: work items live only in backlog/items/<ID>.json (truth), written only by core/backlog.py; open/closed.json are DERIVED indexes
every artifact about work references item_id (BI-####); technical detail adds feature_id (F-x)
derived files are generated, never hand-edited (kind=derived)
new per-scope stores must live under products/<project>/ or product-forge/

open.json.concern: DERIVED lean index of non-terminal work items (id/status/one-liner/dates)

closed.json.concern: DERIVED lean index of terminal work items (no full copies)

settings.json.concern: non-secret tool settings (web_search backend/url); ENV overrides

secrets.json.concern: GITIGNORED tool secrets (web_search api_key); never returned by the API

product.json.concern: product identity, lifecycle, owner, links, versions (BI-0215)

readiness.json.concern: per-agent PRE-execution readiness verdicts (required inputs, context size, model assigned, provider key) with reasons - surfaced via API/events/alarms

model-gate.json.concern: per-agent model capability-fit verdicts (OK/UNKNOWN/INCOMPATIBLE) + recommended substitutes + catalog last_refreshed

run-plan.json.concern: idea-based dynamic run plan: product kind + which OPTIONAL stages to include/skip + rationale (overridable via project.json run_plan)

plan-review.json.concern: human-readable review of optional-capability groups (descriptions + recommendations + evidence) presented before applying the run plan

call-ledger.jsonl.concern: per-LLM-call and per-tool-call payload accounting (prompt/output/reasoning tokens, tool arg/result size, duration) + per-agent/run totals

work-estimate.json.concern: per-agent predicted call shape (llm min/typical/max, tool calls, est minutes) from strategy + plan + call-ledger history

run-status.json.concern: single-writer run/stage/agent status derived from lifecycle events (current stage/phase/agents)

provider-keys.json.concern: provider credential REFERENCES (env var names, never secrets) + budget caps (BI-0207)

traceability.json.concern: requirement<->feature matrix (implemented/tested/reviewed/secured) + cross-agent id_index (BI-PF-1169); requirement_link DELEGATES writes here (BI-PF-1173)

insights.json.concern: canonical cross-project insights store (qa_intelligence + cross_project_learning imported; promotes actionable insights to Product Forge items via B8)

prompts.json.concern: TTY-less prompt bridge (runtime prompts -> requests/answers; BI-0026)

discovery-questions.json.concern: 360-degree discovery questions (3 perspectives) emitted at stage 0a (BI-0028)

discovery-panel.json.concern: 360-degree discovery panel: per-agent clarifying questions + recommended answers + human accept/override

discovery-panel-settings.json.concern: discovery panel settings (agents, sub-agent rollup, max questions)

engineering-flow.json.concern: ENG-0 engineering architecture: ordered requirement->deploy flow mapped to canonical owner files + /api/v1 routes

task-contracts.json.concern: ENG-1 engineering task contracts (TC-<TAG>-<nnn>): the executable unit of work any compatible worker can run (objective, acceptance criteria, paths, capabilities, validation profile)

engineering-workers.json.concern: ENG-2 declared engineering worker pool (types + capabilities + slots) used by the planner/scheduler; runtimes are adapters, never architecture dependencies

worker-results.json.concern: ENG-4 normalized WorkerResult history per task (provider, worktree, branch, base/final commit, files_changed, tests, evidence, status)

pr-records.json.concern: ENG-5 append-only PR records (number/url/head/base/commit_sha/status/adapter/evidence_hash); PR evidence is derived from canonical stores, never duplicated

reservations.json.concern: ENG-8 advisory shared-path reservations (resource, holder task/worker, TTL, held/released) serializing concurrent workers on common code

worker-registry.json.concern: PFSSOT-P6 dynamic worker registry: externally registered execution workers (runtime/capabilities/role/endpoint/workspace) + heartbeat/lifecycle/revocation; scheduler-owned authoritative state. NOT for PF agents.

grooming-guidelines.json.concern: PFSSOT-P2 grooming guidelines (checklist) + cadence (on_entry/on_pickup/on_material_change/periodic) + decision options

shared-paths.json.concern: ENG-8 shared/common-code allowlist (components + globs) + git-hotspot settings

changes.jsonl.concern: append-only engineering change log: drift detected + corrective action (regeneration/redesign/implementation/revert) with before/after, commit and revert refs for traceability

validation-runs.json.concern: ENG-6 run-bound validation-run evidence per profile (FEATURE_PR/INTEGRATION/DOGFOOD/RELEASE): resolved target SHA/base/merge-base + per-check results + PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED + promotion

packaging-manifest.json.concern: REL-0 edition-specific package manifest: source/build/artifact/package/license/entitlement/configuration/deployment_target/runtime_policy + SBOM + upgrade/rollback; generated from canonical owners, human-governed licensing

eap.json.concern: A4 EAP (Edition/Artifact Package) delivery/build manifest: composes the canonical contracts + entitlement + SBOM/build provenance + versioning/compatibility; BUILD-TIME only (not shipped to customers)

eap-registry.json.concern: A4 EAP registry: known EAP schema version(s) + compatibility ranges (current + versions)

release-evidence.jsonl.concern: ENG-10 append-only release evidence: release decision (can_release/unmet) + candidate fingerprint (build/bom/validation run)

deployment-evidence.json.concern: latest deployment result (ran/provider/passed/steps) + history; owner-written and read by the ENG-10 release gate to prove deployment/upgrade/rollback

openapi.json.concern: API-5 canonical OpenAPI snapshot (api/openapi.json) generated from api.app; drift = breaking-change signal

ci-cd-gates.json.concern: BI-PF-1239 DERIVED mechanical-gate registry: projection of scripts/dev/precheck.py::_GATES, kept in lock-step by ci_cd_gates_check.py; read by core/ci_cd_model.py

pidl-profile.json.concern: PIDL profile INDEX (BI-PF-0376): maps decision categories to canonical owner stores (constitution/learnings/persona), review lenses, approval defaults. PIDL owns the index only, never a duplicate personality store.

approval-policy.json.concern: PIDL approval policy (BI-PF-0380): action/area rules that decide whether authenticated human approval is required before a consequential action.

decisions.jsonl.concern: PIDL append-only decision trace (BI-PF-0380): versioned decisions (profile_version, evidence, confidence, risk, approval policy, outcome) for explainability. data/pidl/decisions.jsonl.

model-tier.json.concern: model routing tiers (authoritative: config/model-tier.json; legacy fallback kept)

spec-id-families.json.concern: spec id families (GLOBAL unique vs per-feature LOCAL)

agent-capability-vector.json.concern: per-agent capability vector (reasoning/structured/tools/vision/min_*) driving the capability-aware request builder + reasoning control (BI-0221/0222/0223)

capabilities.json.concern: per-project capability profile: required_capabilities (from modality detection) + enabled_packs (BI-0189)

assets.json.concern: project media asset index: AS-* ids, sha256, type, metadata, children (tiles/segments/frames) (BI-0187)

assets/<id>/**.concern: immutable media blobs under products/<project>/assets/<asset_id>/ (originals + derived parts) (BI-0187)

generator-jobs.json.concern: async generator job store (submit/status/fetch lifecycle for video/music/3d) (BI-0188)

feasibility.json.concern: two-phase feasibility & capability triage: build-host verdict (phase 1) + destination shipping mode (phase 2) (BI-0214)

hardware-tiers.json.concern: per-modality VRAM/RAM/disk tiers + permissive-license list for feasibility (BI-0214)

model-strategy.json.concern: two-phase model & capability strategy decision (Gate A post-0a coarse, Gate B post-architect refined) + applied per-agent model kind/provider (BI-0192/BI-0210)

learning-candidates.json.concern: evidence-gated candidate learnings/overlays/skills/knowledge (proposed -> approved/rejected); applied into owner stores only after approval (BI-PF-0293)

learnings.json.concern: de-duplicated, compact generalized learnings distilled from RCCA (similar rules merge; store + render are size-capped so prompts never bloat)

plugins-registry.json.concern: generic plugin/registry (ports & adapters): provider/tool/stage/validator/agent entries + adapter (module:callable) outside core/ (BI-0200)

mcp-servers.json.concern: external MCP servers Product Forge consumes (transport/command) (BI-0196)

a2a-remotes.json.concern: remote A2A agent peers (whitelist; contract-based delegation) (BI-0197)

provider-health.json.concern: rolling provider availability/rate-limit/error/latency outcomes feeding routing (BI-PF-0279)

idempotency.json.concern: API idempotency keys -> stored results (replay/conflict), TTL-bounded (API-0.1)

model-policy.json.concern: versioned per-model eligibility policy (allowed/restricted tasks, cost, quality, fallback, review) (BI-PF-0278)

guardrail-policy.json.concern: output guardrail policy: channels x categories x action (allow|flag|block|redact) + governance checkpoints (BI-0219)

plan-groups.json.concern: optional-capability groups for the post-discovery run planner

product_forge_context.json.concern: Product Forge context (file renamed from factory_context.json; owner still the deprecated dashboard - reassign on rewrite, BI-0050)

agent_ledger.jsonl.concern: legacy fallback only when core unavailable (standalone test-framework)

model-fit.json.concern: per-tier model/agent capability-fit report + applied substitutions (BI-0076)

features.json.concern: test-run feature results, keyed by feature_id -> links product-plan (item via feature.backlog_id)

pipeline-execution-report.json.concern: pipeline execution report (derived; companion to final-report.json)

pipeline.json.concern: DERIVED projection of project.json + pipeline-state.json (legacy readers; BI-0005 split+retire)

project.json.concern: project descriptor/truth (single-writer facade core/project_store.py; reads unchanged)

run-scope.json.concern: run scope (stages/features covered by this run)

skills-registry.json.concern: skills registry (canonical spelling; legacy skills_registry.json -> BI-0006)

index.json.concern: project registry (products/index.json) - list of known projects

issues.json.concern: stage agent issue reports (evidence; folded into defects + bug items via defect_loop.route_stage_issues)

artifact-formats.json.concern: dynamic artifact output formats (default md; agent/kind/project extras + content heuristics) (BI-0110)

pipeline-plan.json.concern: per-project customized pipeline plan (enabled optional stages + display numbering)

.learned-knowledge.json.concern: per-project learned knowledge (needs researched on the net)

review-ledger.json.concern: review/feedback ledger (producer, artifact, reviewer, feedback, resolution)

dashboard-blueprint.json.concern: reusable dashboard+API blueprint (Product Forge + every project)

rerun-review.json.concern: latest rerun review (existing inputs + recommendations + operator decision)

_stage.json.concern: per-stage display name + agents + artifacts index (3a)

log-conventions.json.concern: log layout + file naming (product runs / pipeline backend / dashboard)

INDEX.json.concern: per-run log index (logs/<run_id>/INDEX.json: which agents logged, sizes)

pf-review-scope.json.concern: PF review/advisory scope: scopes declared LEGACY (excluded from reciprocity/duplicates/api_impact checks, retained in backlog) + dashboard_reciprocity active flag

language-rule.json.concern: A6 language rule (BI-PF-0395): shipped/sensitive roots, allowlist for governance Python, legacy exemptions - enforces the LOCKED Go-first baseline (BI-PF-0387/0388) via scripts/dev/language_rule_check.py; single reader core/change_policy.py

api-first-baseline.json.concern: API-first enforcement baseline (ADR-0007/0008; BI-PF-1404): grandfathered item ids so the api-first gate (scripts/dev/api_first_check.py) is fatal only for NEW items; single reader scripts/dev/api_first_check.py

backlog-dod-baseline.json.concern: Hard DoD gate baseline (BI-PF-1410): grandfathered item ids for detailed Acceptance Criteria + independent verification, so the gate is fatal only for NEW items; single reader scripts/dev/backlog_dod_check.py

backlog-verification-baseline.json.concern: Independent-verification gate baseline (BI-PF-1413): grandfathered delivered item ids (verifier != implementer); single reader scripts/dev/backlog_verification_check.py

dogfood-schedule.json.concern: DOGFOOD Phase 3 (BI-PF-0460) schedule: enabled entries {project, idea, tier, auto, interval_hours, last_run}, ticked by an external cron via POST /dogfood/schedule/tick; single writer core/dogfood_schedule.py

items.jsonl.concern: append-only intake entries per channel (IN-#### + source)

intake-files/<name>.concern: stored original intake files (any type: md/txt/pdf/doc/docx/rtf/images) under products/intake/_files/<source>/ + best-effort extracted text

run-manifests/<run_id>.json.concern: run-bound artifact/approval provenance (F0-3): per-run artifact paths + sha256 + decisions

verification-policy.json.concern: close-on-verify criteria per scope + report locations

verification.html.concern: static close-on-verify status + attached report links

context-policy.json.concern: per-agent FULL vs SUMMARY input policy + required inputs

model-catalog.json.concern: per-model capability metadata fetched from providers (context/max_output/tools/reasoning/structured/modality/pricing)

tool-catalog.json.concern: third-party tool/SDK/vendor/generator license metadata + bundle_allowed (BI-0211); gates packaging

id-blocks.json.concern: reserved backlog id blocks per (scope,project,session) for collision-safe id allocation (BI-PF-0462)

artifact-owners.json.concern: canonical product-artifact -> owner agent -> consumers map, rendered to docs/ARTIFACT-OWNERS.md (BI-PF-0765)

review-focus.json.concern: production-risk review checklist consumed by the code-review agent, rendered to docs/REVIEW-FOCUS.md (BI-PF-1066)

compliance-register.json.concern: framework->control->evidence compliance register, rendered to docs/COMPLIANCE-REGISTER.md (BI-PF-1206)

data-plane-threats.json.concern: data-plane threat register (6 threat categories -> source/sink/control/owner/evidence), rendered to docs/EDP-DATA-PLANE-THREAT-MODEL.md (BI-PF-1296 / EDP-04)

database.json.concern: system-of-record PostgreSQL config (non-secret pool settings, roles, migrations dir); DSN via PF_DB_DSN env (BI-PF-1309 / EDP-17)

knowledge-registry.json.concern: add/modify/view knowledge bases, skills, techstacks, domains, guidelines, MCP (router/catalog source)

otel-spans.jsonl.concern: OTel-style spans derived from the event stream (flag-gated PIPELINE_OTEL)

legacy-frozen.json.concern: frozen legacy files (hash guard: do not edit/delete)

items/<ID>.json.concern: TRUTH - one full work item per file (the API reads/writes only this)

issues/items/<IS>.json.concern: TRUTH - one finding per file (IS-<TAG>-<nnn>) with priority/module/RCCA + 1:1 backlog_ref; open/closed are DERIVED indexes

issues/<stage>-<agent>-issues.json.concern: legacy per-stage/agent audit issue lists (fail-safe fallback store; folded into canonical issues via core/issues.ingest_stage_issues, BI-PF-0272)

history/<ID>.jsonl.concern: append-only journal per item (status + content changes)

changes/<ID>-functional.md.concern: auto-generated functional spec for change/new backlog items (BI-0183)

quality-gate.json.concern: latest repo quality-gate result for item/amend runs (BI-0184)
